build_excel_backend: build an MsExcelDocumentBackend to parse an Excel workbook into a DoclingDocument with tables and images
create_excel_cell: create an ExcelCell model representing a cell with row, column, text, and span information
create_excel_table: create an ExcelTable model representing a rectangular table with anchor, dimensions, and cell data
test_find_tables: test the _find_data_tables method to discover compact rectangular tables in an Excel worksheet
summarize_convert_workbook: summarize the _convert_workbook method that converts all sheets into pages with tables and images
